name: Monad Bot
description: Generates a Monad wallet the first time you use it, holds onto the address across sessions, and signs transactions from it on request. Funding is your job — it arrives empty and stays that way until you send it something.

official.title: Monad Bot by Jarrod
official.description: Creates a Monad wallet on first use, remembers it, and sends transactions from it. You fund the address.
